name: QuantumFleet AI
description: Route optimisation for mid-size freight fleets. Re-plans loads against live traffic and order data to cut empty-mile running, which is roughly 28% of distance travelled for the target segment.
team: Two ex-Flipkart supply-chain engineers and an operations lead who ran a 200-truck regional fleet for six years.
extras: Stage: Seed. Team size: 6. Raising $500k at a $4M cap. Four paying pilots, $9k MRR, 11% month-on-month growth.
_note: Strong case. Matches the sandbox registry name, so it auto-verifies.

name: LedgerLoom
description: Automated bank reconciliation for small businesses. Matches statement lines to invoices and flags the exceptions an accountant should look at.
team: A chartered accountant and two backend engineers. No one has sold to SMEs before.
extras: Stage: Pre-seed. 40 unpaid beta users, no revenue. Raising $150k.
_note: Mixed case: credible product, unproven commercially.

name: MediScan Diagnostics
description: Chest X-ray triage that flags likely abnormalities for radiologist review. Claims 94% sensitivity on an internal validation set of 12,000 studies.
team: A radiologist with 15 years of practice, an ML researcher from IIT Bombay, and a regulatory consultant.
extras: Stage: Series A. Deployed in 7 hospitals. Raising $3M. CDSCO approval pending.
_note: Regulatory risk is the story; the analyst should surface it.

name: AgriSense Networks
description: Soil moisture and nutrient sensors with an advisory app for smallholder farms. Hardware is sold at cost; revenue comes from an annual advisory subscription.
team: Three agricultural engineers. One previously ran a 400-farmer cooperative.
extras: Stage: Seed. 2,300 sensors deployed across Maharashtra. ₹40 lakh ARR. Raising ₹4 crore.
_note: Hardware margins and churn are the questions to ask.

name: VaultKey Security
description: Passwordless authentication for mid-market SaaS. A drop-in SDK replacing password login with device-bound passkeys.
team: Solo technical founder, ex-security engineer. Actively hiring a co-founder.
extras: Stage: Pre-seed. Open-source SDK with 1,800 GitHub stars, no paying customers. Raising $250k.
_note: Single-founder and monetisation risk; strong developer signal.

name: NeoCredit Score
description: Alternative credit scoring for thin-file borrowers using transaction and telecom data. Claims to approve 3x more applicants at the same default rate.
team: Two founders from a large NBFC's risk team.
extras: Stage: Seed. Claims partnerships with 'multiple leading banks' but names none. Raising $1.2M.
_note: Weak case: unverifiable claims. Tests whether the report stays sceptical.
